name: Sharding Vajra
body:
Prerequisite(s): 5th level stormbound

Benefit(s): When the vajrin confirms a critical hit with their Vajra veil, or if a creature fails their Reflex saving throw against its Hands bind effect with a natural 1, it leaves behind shards of electrified crystalline akasha in the affected creature. These shards cause such a creature to take 1 point of magical slashing damage and 1 point of electricity damage at the start of each of their turns. The damage from the storm power ignores any electricity resistance, electricity immunity, or damage reduction a creature might possess unless the damage reduction is adamantine, — or epic. This damage can be ended early with a successful DC 15 Heal check or through the application of any spell or magical effect that cures hit point damage. The damage from this storm power stacks with itself up to a number of points of each type of damage equal to the vajrin’s veilweaving modifier.
